title: “Oops, Did I Just Say That?” Testing and Repairing Unethical Suggestions of Large Language Models with Suggest-Critique-Reflect Process

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to contextualized moral situations (using the ETHICSSUITE benchmark) via a Suggest-Critique-Reflect (SCR) automated test oracle. A critic LLM evaluates the ethicality of the tested LLM's initial suggestion, and the tested LLM reflects on the critique to identify and flag its own unethical behavior.
